notes:
- SMB mobile games studio building social/competitive titles. Primary product: live match lobbies + 1:1 chat.
- Current infra: Firebase auth + GCP for backend. Lean infra team (2 backend, 1 mobile).
- Pain: chat responses must be fast (<150ms ideally) to avoid UX jitter; also need inline abuse checks for user messages and prompt-level filters.
- Cost sensitive: free-to-play monetization so token spend needs to be predictable; looking for batching and streaming to reduce perceived latency.
- They signed up for self-serve, already called API once (low volume). Want to run a 2-week POC using hosted API.
- CTO quote: "We can't add ~300ms to every chat — it ruins the flow. Also need a way to auto-block abusive messages without blocking legit banter."
- Interested in streaming responses, message-level moderation hooks, per-route rate limits and soft-fallback (cheaper quantized model) when heavy load.
- Legal: wants EU residency for European player base; will accept SOC2 for production but POC can run on hosted.
- Integration notes: plan to proxy messages through backend to attach player metadata; mobile SDKs will call backend which then streams from Redwood.
- POC success criteria: average per-message L90 latency <200ms, moderation false positives <2% on internal dataset, cost per MAU within projected budget.
- References: pricing deck (drive link), sample message histogram attached to email thread (thread-67890).
